reply: The 7-point score is 5, which is at or above the threshold of 3, and the criteria_implied_action is excision. The pattern model diagnosed NEV with 60% confidence, but this conflicts with the checklist result; no guideline recommendation exists for NEV, but for melanoma, the contingent guidelines recommend complete excision with narrow margins (1–3 mm) when melanoma is suspected, as per DOI:10.1016/j.ejca.2024.115153.
